description: This file defines the FavoritesController class for managing article favoriting functionality in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes endpoints for adding and removing articles from favorites, secured with JWT authorization.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller handling favorite/unfavorite operations for articles via HTTP POST and DELETE endpoints, utilizing mediator pattern for command handling.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST request to mark an article as favorite; sends Add.Command via mediator.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an article from favorites; sends Delete.Command via mediator.
